entities.summary: Miroslav Raduljica is a Serbian former professional basketball player. He currently plays as a forward for FK Železničar Inđija of the Serbian SuperLiga. He has also represented the Serbian national team in international competition. Standing at 2.13 m, he plays at the center position.
